about: Session of loading a party preset (PartyPreset.lsf), created by bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 (called from the per-frame update of esv::party_preset::System); read by esv::recruit::RecruitmentSystem and esv::script::GlobalFlagsLoadSystem::LoadStoryFlagsFile (macOS WorldViews).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x2DC1470 initialises an ls::STDString at +0 (size +0x10 = 0, capacity +0x14 = 0xF, first byte 0); destructor bg3.exe+0x22B7260 frees it when capacity > 0xF. bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 assigns it (bg3.exe+0x41214D0) the part of the preset path between the last '/' and '.' (bg3.exe+0x4120CE0 with 0x2F and 0x2E), or a whole string.

Creator zeroes a HashSet at +0x18..+0x48; destructor calls bg3.exe+0x582AD0 (POD HashSet destructor) on +0x18. bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 inserts 8-byte values with bg3.exe+0x721030 (the value comes from a local structure on the stack). Key assumed EntityHandle (8 bytes; not proven). Second pass: bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 line 985 inserts with bg3.exe+0x721030 into comp + 0x18 (HashSet insert, 8-byte keys compared as one value).

Creator zeroes a HashSet at +0x48..+0x78; destructor bg3.exe+0x582AD0 on +0x48. bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 inserts every 8-byte element of a local array (bg3.exe+0x721030 into comp + 0x48). Key assumed EntityHandle. Second pass: bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 lines 450-453 insert only values that pass the entity-handle validity test (>>0x36 < 0x41 and != 0xFFC0000000000000) - entity handles.

Creator writes the null handle 0xFFC0000000000000; bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 stores the preset entry's handle (+0x38 of the preset record) when it is valid, later read back and checked with IsWorldPositionOnGrid.
Creator writes 0xFFFFFFFF; destructor DecRefs it as a FixedString; bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 sets it (with IncRef) from the preset when still empty.
bg3.exe+0x2DBC980: byte store from preset record byte +0x41 (creator zeroes +0x84..+0x87 with one 4-byte store).
bg3.exe+0x2DBC980: byte store from preset record byte +0x40; later tested == 0 before using field_78.
bg3.exe+0x2DBC980: byte store from preset record byte +0x42 (the same byte selects how PresetName is built).

survey.live_reason: no live or captured instance: needs a situation that creates it
survey.names_pass_2: No game names: not saved, not replicated, no Osiris parameter maps to it.
open_questions: Meaning of the two entity sets, the handle at +0x78, the FixedString at +0x80 and the three flag bytes +0x84..+0x86 (copied from preset record bytes +0x41, +0x40, +0x42).
Not seen alive (seen.py has no samples).
survey.second_pass: All offsets and widths were already from the Windows creator bg3.exe+0x2DC1470, destructor bg3.exe+0x22B7260 and filler bg3.exe+0x2DBC980; the second pass confirmed both sets take 8-byte entity handles (bg3.exe+0x721030 inserts after an entity validity test). Names remain unknown.
